nodes.notes: 2x2 Mach–Zehnder Interferometer including integrated thermo-optic heaters on one or both arms for phase tuning. Expose optical ports indexed at least 0..3 (per library convention). Electrical heater pads are part of this block.
Single grating coupler with one optical port (port 0). Orientation/tilt/polarization per PDK defaults unless otherwise specified.

notes: Optical connection: MZI optical port 0 -> Grating coupler optical port 0.
All other MZI optical ports remain unconnected unless otherwise specified.
No separate heater blocks; heaters are integrated within the MZI block.
